StubHub — Software Engineer, Core Compute Platform
Remote
Mid Level
Join StubHub's Core Compute Platform team building the internal compute platform that powers product engineering.
You will design reusable SDKs and platform interfaces, operate Kubernetes and Terraform on AWS, and reduce engineer cognitive load through self-serve developer enablement.
Build backend platform services and APIs consumed by other engineers — not end-user product features.
Strong experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering required.
